info.title: BoomReport API
info.description:
Rent reporting (BoomReport) endpoints of the Boom Partner API: create customers, enroll them, keep lease terms current, and report rental payments that Boom furnishes to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion.

**Authentication.** `POST /partner/v1/authenticate` with your API key pair returns a JWT; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Keys are created self-serve under Settings → API in the Boom Partner Platform. Read-only keys may only call GET endpoints (writes return 403 `forbidden`). Keys scoped to owners or property groups only see matching records; anything else answers 404.

**Conventions.** JSON request and response bodies. Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header. Errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"message", "status", "code", "request_id"}}`. Lists use one envelope with `page` / `per_page` (max 1000) and a deterministic newest-first order. Money is `{cents, currency}`. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, timestamps ISO 8601 UTC. See the Errors, Pagination, Rate limits and Versioning guides on docs.boompay.app.

The screening (BoomScreen) and CRM endpoints are documented in the companion BoomScreen API specification.

post.summary: Report rental payments for one or more months
post.description: Each item is processed independently and the outcome is returned per item: `verify` (paid on time), `delinquency` (paid late by `months_delinquency` months), `reject` (`no_data`). Verified months are furnished to the bureaus in the next reporting cycle. **This call has consequences on the customer's credit file; do not retry blindly on a network error** — fetch the enrollment and inspect `rental_verifications` for the month first.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid bearer token

403.description: Read-only API key used for a write

404.description: No such record for this partner (also returned for records outside the API key's owner / property-group scope)

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation id for this request. Quote it when contacting support. Supply your own (1–128 chars of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_`, `.`, `-`) and it is echoed back; otherwise one is generated.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per rolling minute for this client.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window (0 when throttled).

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the window resets.

Error.description: Generic business-rule failure. `code` is present on most paths; a few legacy business errors carry only `message` (and sometimes `errors`).

message.example: First name is missing, phone is invalid
The request body is not valid application/json

Forbidden.description: Also returned when a read-only API key attempts a write.

message.example: Too many requests. Please try again later.
An internal error occurred of type 3f2a9c. Error ID: 7b1e…

error_signature.description: Stable hash of the failure class; identical for repeats of the same bug.

has_more.description: True when a following page exists.

extra.description: Reserved for endpoint-specific metadata. Usually null; may be absent.

PaginatedList.description: Envelope shared by every list endpoint. See the Pagination guide for ordering guarantees.

access_key.description: Customer access key for the embedded SDK. Null for partners on expiring SDK authentication (use `issue_access_token`).

access_token.description: Short-lived SDK token for this customer.

description.example: We were unable to verify your bank account. Please reconnect your bank.

for_month.description: First day of the reported month.

monthly_rent_amount.description: Monthly rent in dollars. Prefer `monthly_rent`, which carries cents and currency like every other money field in the API.

status.description: Enrollment status. New values may be added; see the status dictionary.

products.description: Reporting products on the enrollment, e.g. `ongoing`, `past_reporting`.

no_data.description: True when you have no payment record for the month.

processor_tokens.description: Plaid processor tokens to link at creation.

AddressUpdate.description: Any subset of address fields; address1, city, state_or_province and postal_code must be supplied together.
